title.from: Pilobol.us P3-12: rebuild-on-publish live proof (StartJob from publish/unpublish) on the proof branch
title.to: Pilobol.us P3-08: rebuild-on-publish live proof (StartJob from publish/unpublish)

description.from:
## Goal
Prove rebuild-on-publish live for Pilobol.us: publishing (and unpublishing) in the newsroom starts a build of the reader through IAM amplify:StartJob, with no webhook URL and no token. Proven on the cms-reader proof branch, not on production pages.

## Context (FACT)
- PR #125: content-actions Lambda, after a changed publishItem/unpublishItem, calls Amplify StartJob for the reader app (PAPYRUS_READER_AMPLIFY_APP_ID) and branch; a PENDING job suppresses a new start; a RUNNING job does not block; unchanged publishes trigger nothing; errors never fail the publish. IAM: amplify:StartJob and ListJobs only on apps/<id>/branches/<branch>/jobs/* of the configured apps. CLI: papyrus content rebuild --reader --app-id <id>; content publish|unpublish trigger after an applied change.
- The backend config reader { amplifyAppId, branchName } lives in papyrus.config.ts (scaffold sets d1od6t7lzbwanr and main). The ARN form of the IAM resource is flagged UNVERIFIED in PR #125 ("start-job --debug shows the resource").
- Live proof of the Lambda itself was done in a sandbox (PR #127); never against Amplify StartJob.
- The reader main branch is still Git-built until the cutover ticket; cms-reader builds from the CMS with the parity gate.

## Exact steps
1. In the Pilobol.us scaffold config set reader.branchName to cms-reader for the proof period (PR; the CMS main build redeploys the backend config: LIVE via the normal merge + build, Ryan yes).
2. Create a throwaway draft: a scratch dir with articles/zz-rebuild-proof.md (a short harmless test article, never narrated, front matter audio false) imported with --no-publish.
3. In /newsroom open the draft, Publish (the editor UI, so the Lambda path is exercised). Expected: result message contains rebuild started; aws amplify list-jobs --app-id d1od6t7lzbwanr --branch-name cms-reader shows a new RUNNING then SUCCEED job; the proof URL https://cms-reader.d1od6t7lzbwanr.amplifyapp.com/articles/zz-rebuild-proof.html appears (the parity gate must be OFF on cms-reader for this test: unset PILOBOL_PARITY_LIVE_URL first, LIVE env change, Ryan yes).
4. Publish a second test change quickly while the first job is PENDING/RUNNING: expect reason pending-job-exists for PENDING; a RUNNING job does not block (a queued job).
5. Unpublish in the UI: a job runs and the page is gone from the proof URL. Leave the Item as an unpublished draft (do not delete: Ryan's call) and record its id.
6. Check CloudWatch logs of the content-actions Lambda: no errors; aws iam get-role-policy shows StartJob only on apps/d1od6t7lzbwanr (the ARN form works if the job started).
7. Restore PILOBOL_PARITY_LIVE_URL on cms-reader.

## Acceptance checks
- Jobs started by publish and by unpublish, no webhook or token involved; PENDING suppression observed; no production page changed (live pilobol.us verify-parity 94/94 afterwards).

## Rollback
Unpublish the test item; delete nothing without Ryan; revert the config PR if the IAM ARN form is wrong.

## Risks
- The IAM ARN pattern is the known unverified point: fix in Papyrus (rebuild-trigger-settings.ts) if the Lambda gets AccessDenied.
- A rebuild-on-publish job on main after cutover will not run the parity gate: that is intended (real new content).

## Needs Ryan
Yes for the env change on cms-reader and the config deploy; he clicks Publish/Unpublish in the newsroom (or approves the agent doing it with his session).

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.

## Goal
Prove rebuild-on-publish live: publish and unpublish in the newsroom start a reader build through IAM amplify:StartJob, no webhook URL, no token.

## Context (FACT)
- PR #125: content-actions Lambda calls StartJob for the reader (PAPYRUS_READER_AMPLIFY_APP_ID, branch) after a changed publish/unpublish; a PENDING job suppresses a new start; unchanged publishes trigger nothing; errors never fail the publish; IAM only amplify:StartJob and ListJobs on apps/<id>/branches/<branch>/jobs/*. The ARN form is flagged unverified in #125. CLI: papyrus content rebuild --reader --app-id <id>.
- Pre-production site: a test article is acceptable on the reader; unpublish afterwards.

## Exact steps
1. Ensure papyrus.config.ts backend.reader is the new reader app id, branch main (scaffold/new-apps tickets); deploy through the CMS main build.
2. Import a throwaway draft (scratch dir with articles/zz-rebuild-proof.md, audio false) with --no-publish; in /newsroom click Publish. Expect a new reader job (aws amplify list-jobs --app-id <reader> --branch-name main) that SUCCEEDs and the page appears; click Publish again at once: pending-job-exists; then Unpublish: job runs, page gone.
3. Check the Lambda logs for errors and aws iam get-role-policy shows StartJob only on the reader app. Leave the item an unpublished draft.

## Acceptance checks
Jobs started by publish and unpublish; suppression seen; no AccessDenied.

## Rollback
Unpublish the test item; if the ARN form is wrong fix rebuild-trigger-settings.ts in Papyrus.

## Risks
IAM ARN form unverified.

## Needs Ryan
He clicks Publish/Unpublish (or says the agent may use his session).

## Common rules (Phase 3 Pilobol.us, simplified plan v2)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (PR AnthusAI/Papyrus#128). Ryan 2026-10-06: Pilobol.us is PRE-PRODUCTION, Git history is the rollback, HARD CUTOVER: no soak, no Git freeze, no dual Git/CMS build path, no parity gate, brief downtime is fine. New Amplify apps are created from the template; the old apps and the old EMPTY backend are retired at the end.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan (or on his explicit yes).
- Never build in /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us (its build rewrites content): use a fresh clone or a worktree.
- Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo: feature branch + PR, never push to its main. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus only run kbs.
- Keep article text verbatim (the importer already does; narration hashes depend on it). The Auritus embed is origin-locked to the site key's origin; the production origin stays pilobol.us, so nothing changes there (narration will not play on temporary amplifyapp.com URLs: expected).
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.
